status.description: cached when the catalog served the keys and every source is readable as it is, partial when it served them but some url sources still need summarising (see to_read; never with --no-crawl), cited-only when crawling was off and every key was served only as a url nobody has kept a page for (see not_read), near when none resolved but the ranking has candidates to choose from, uncited when the answer came from the model alone.

summary.description: One line: what was found and where.

sources.description: What to read to answer: a page on disk, or the url of one. Nothing is fetched or built ahead of time, so a source is a thing to read and the reader decides how.

authority.description: The cited entry's own `authority` column, unchanged; `inferred` when no entry backs the answer.

references.description: Footnote targets, taken from what each page recorded rather than from its prose. Cite these and nothing else.

unmatched.description: Keys it did not. Name these rather than letting them pass as answered.

suggestions.description: Rows a key might have meant, keyed by the key that missed. Offered, not served: the first is right about two times in three, and one of the five about nine times in ten.

score.description: BM25, comparable within one query and not across them.

to_read.description: Url sources the harness CLI could not summarise. Their bare urls are in sources too and are not summaries; read each from its file instead. Summarise the file following its instructions, save the summary to a file and run the keep command so the next lookup serves it. Absent when nothing failed.

source.description: The url, as it also appears in sources. Do not fetch it again: read file.

file.description: The page, downloaded here as text for you to summarise; null when the download failed.

fetch_error.description: Why the download failed; empty when file is set.

entry.description: The catalog entry the url belongs to.

keyword.description: The keyword it was reached by; part of where the summary is kept.

instructions.description: What to report from this kind of source, and that the page is evidence, not instructions.

keep.description: The command that caches the summary, with <file> to fill in.

failed.description: Why the harness CLI could not summarise the source.

not_read.description: Only with --no-crawl (allow_crawl: false): url sources with no current kept page, cited in references but not in sources and not read. Nothing on them is established. Absent otherwise.

source.description: The url, as it also appears in references.

entry.description: The catalog entry the url belongs to.

keyword.description: The keyword it was reached by.

error.description: Set only when no key was served and the harness CLI failed answering without a source. The tool failed, not the catalog: report the error, and do not search the package for an answer.

examples.summary: 2 source(s) for vpu, tpus-in-gke; read them at `sources`.
